title: Enhancing individual glomerular filtration rate assessment: can we trust the equation? Development and validation of machine learning models to assess the trustworthiness of estimated GFR compared to
summary: A random forest estimates whether creatinine-based EKFC eGFR is within 30% of measured GFR; external validation across 10,107 participants produced AUC 0.675 and accuracy 0.716, with specificity 0.485 at the stated threshold. It marginally improves population-level trustworthiness and supports individual uncertainty assessment, not replacement of measured GFR.
